business_problem: Typically, community banks lack the IT resources of major national or regional operators, often relying on legacy technology.
solution_summary: Typically, community banks lack the IT resources of major national or regional operators, often relying on legacy technology. Establishing a flexible, distributed, document-store database Neocova Talk to an Expert Neocova provides community banks with critical access to data insight Industry Software Product MongoDB Atlas MongoDB Compass Atlas Charts Use Case Analytics Customer Since 2020 INTRODUCTION The backbone of local communities In many ways, community banks are the backbone of the US financial services system. Greater insight into real-time data enables community banks to be more local and more personal. THE SOLUTION Establishing a flexible, distributed, document-store database As they searched for a solution, Neocova was already familiar with MongoDB, as many on the team had used Atlas in previous roles.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas Charts
solution_components.role: Visualizes operational and analytics data for business and engineering teams.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Compass
solution_components.role: Helps engineers inspect data, troubleshoot issues, and speed debugging on live datasets.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the operational data and provides the managed document database foundation for Neocova's workload.

data_flow: Operational events and application data flow into MongoDB Atlas Charts, where the platform stores current state and supports real-time queries for downstream applications.
metrics: Beecher cites the example of one commercial bank that estimated it was missing out on around $1 million a year in revenue from lost merchant fee opportunities.
“We ran through the analytics and the figure wasn’t $1 million, it was $5 million in revenue transacting outside the bank,” he recalls.
